entities.summary: Magyar, a notable figure in the history of Czechia, associated with Great Moravia & Přemyslid Dynasty (800–907). Preceded by Great Moravian Empire. Their legacy influenced Mission of Saints Cyril and Methodius to Great Moravia and Golden Bull.
